ops.title: daemonkit v0.20.6 deferred-untrack: bridge-test adaptation + two audited-unchanged Store.Load sites
ops.body:
daemonkit 85d53fd (v0.20.6) defers durable untrack off the child settlement path: PreparedChild.Stop returning nil no longer implies the store record is gone (daemonkit CHANGELOG: consumers that inspect the store immediately after a settled child must poll or wait for shutdown). Bisected during the v0.27.3 repin: daemonkit v0.20.6 + old synckit v0.35.2 reproduces, so daemonkit alone is the trigger.

Adaptation shipped in v0.27.3: waitBridgeUntracked (bounded 5s/10ms poll, matching the file idiom) at both one-shot post-settlement Store.Load sites in internal/daemon/bridge_processes_test.go — TestBridgeRecordedFailsClosedWhenSessionParentSyncFails (was 3-5/10 flaky under v0.20.6) and TestBridgeProcessShutdownLeavesNoAuthorityOrMetadata (identical latent race). No production code changed.

Two sibling Store.Load sites deliberately left unchanged, audited not skipped: internal/daemon/bridge_processes.go:300 — the production settleRecovery reconcile may now observe transiently-present settled records; whether its semantics tolerate that under the new contract is a design question worth its own pass — and runtime_test.go:365 (reaped via the recovery path, not deferred untrack, with an existing 500ms tolerance).
